remainingIssues: C7-NATIVE-LOD-AV-01: Unresolved prior native LOD original-export fatal0xC0000005 remains open for C7/native qualification. Targeted44-check replay and32 fixed GC rounds did not reproduce it; no product AV fix is claimed, and the final bounded software pass does not prove the fault resolved.
Force layout publishes only a bounded final result; continuous physical simulation and intermediate iteration-frame animation remain open.
This stage implements nine catalog modes using four numeric layout engines; complete C6, full official API/binary/default behavior and licensed vendor runtime comparison remain open.

Graph source budgets are 2000 nodes / 10000 edges; force layout is capped at 400 nodes and 300 iterations; crossing sweeps are capped at 32. UI source mapping, snapshot capture, native geometry and export rendering remain synchronous.

Sankey SCC return lanes and barycentric sweeps are bounded heuristics, not optimal crossing minimization or collision-free routing. Non-conserving interior nodes are explicit diagnostics unless strict mode rejects them.

Force layout can retain caller-pinned overlaps or use deterministic grid fallback; convergence and final displacement are diagnostics, not proof of globally optimal force energy or animation smoothness.

Flow groups are named-node enclosures. Arbitrary group DTO bounds/style, node icons/templates/per-item brushes, individual edge arrow options, professional label routing and graph-editing interactions remain open.

Zero-weight edges retain snapshot/numeric identity and are omitted by rendering; positive-flow chord nodes with no incident mass retain zero sectors and are omitted by rendering. Extreme positive ratios may underflow or become subpixel; business data are retained.

New-family formal C4-08 performance, percentile latency, process/native/GPU memory, physical Windows/Linux input, native Wayland/ARM/distributions/multi-DPI and 30-minute/8-hour long-soak qualification remain open.
C2 professional shared interactions, complete C5/statistical follow-up and C6-06 catalog audit remain open where not explicitly tested.
Million-point hit p95 and A11Y-NATIVE-01 remain deferred by user; historical AX06/PixelProbe/animation/long-path/default-JIT issues remain retained.
